cases.purpose: Header includes interval, command, host/time and the command output below it.
cases.oracle: Pinned Debian procps 4.0.4 watch and procps watch(1): semantic screen positions and rendition, documented error text/status and terminal restoration. Hostname/time are patterned, never fixed to a host.
cases.comparison: The private PTY captures raw bytes, decoded screen, step events, status and initial/final termios; the reference must satisfy fixed predicates and each side is evaluated separately. A guarded owned PTY adapter runs the same ordered predicates, retains full live termios and events, and attempts only bounded cleanup after a failed step; later steps remain unexercised.
